title: THE MAGNUM KICKS THE SCREEN HARDER
why: His Q5: gun feel. The Magnum shared the heavy-gun kick of 4.5 with the Longshot, 1.9 px. A 62 damage shot every 0.62 s should hit harder: 5.5 gives 2.8 px, and the shake drains in 0.28 s so shots never stack.
now: The Magnum now kicks the screen harder with every shot.

edits.replacement: var GUN_SHAKE={shotgun:6.5,smg:1.9,pistol:3.6,rifle:2.7,magnum:5.5};   // v28.xx (cw-kickmagnum): the Magnum 4.5 to 5.5, one shot 1.9 px to 2.8 px of camera kick (trauma 0.321 to 0.393, size 18 x trauma squared), draining in 0.28 s, well inside its 620 ms rate so shots never stack
